title: Crispy Uruguayan Empanadas with Spicy Aromatic Beef
description: A twist on traditional Mexican empanadas, these crispy Uruguayan-style treats are filled with spicy aromatic beef and perfect for a flavorful snack or meal.

ingredients.name: Aromatic Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: Ground cumin, chili powder, and smoked paprika

ingredients.name: Score (For Baking)
ingredients.notes: For brushing empanadas with egg wash

ingredients.name: Empanada Filling
ingredients.notes: Beef, onion, garlic, and Aromatic Spice Blend

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the Uruguayan Beef, Aromatic Spice Blend, salt, and black pepper. Mix well.
Roll out the Crispy Empanada Dough to a thickness of 1/8 inch. Cut out circles of dough.
Place a spoonful of the Empanada Filling in the center of each dough circle.
Brush the edges of the dough with the Score and fold the dough over the filling, pressing the edges to seal.
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the Fat.
Place the empanadas on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake the empanadas for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
